description: This file defines C++ structures, functions, and APIs related to autograd C++ functions interfaced with Python. It manages Python bindings for C++ autograd nodes, including creation, registration, and property access, facilitating integration between C++ autograd functionalities and Python.

classes.name: THPCppFunction
classes.description: A C++ structure representing a Python object that wraps an autograd Node with reference counting.

methods.name: TORCH_PYTHON_API PyObject * CppFunction_pynew(PyTypeObject * type,PyObject * args,PyObject * kwds)
methods.description: Creates a new instance of a Python object wrapping a C++ autograd Node using a provided constructor.

methods.name: THPCppFunction_next_functions
methods.description: Returns the next functions in the autograd graph.

methods.name: THPCppFunction_metadata
methods.description: Returns metadata related to the autograd function.

methods.name: THPCppFunction_requires_grad
methods.description: Indicates if the function requires gradient computation.

methods.name: THPCppFunction_register_hook_dict
methods.description: Registers a hook dictionary for the autograd function.

methods.name: THPCppFunction_register_hook
methods.description: Registers a hook callback for the autograd function.

methods.name: THPCppFunction_register_prehook
methods.description: Registers a pre-hook callback for the autograd function.

methods.name: THPCppFunction_name
methods.description: Returns the name of the autograd function.

methods.name: THPCppFunction_sequence_nr
methods.description: Returns the sequence number of the autograd function.

methods.name: THPCppFunction_input_metadata
methods.description: Returns input metadata for the autograd function.

methods.name: registerCppFunction
methods.description: Registers a C++ autograd function type with the Python interface.

methods.name: functionToPyObject
methods.description: Converts a shared_ptr<Node> to a Python object.

methods.name: TORCH_PYTHON_API PyTypeObject * createForwardFunctionPyTypeObject(PyTypeObject & type,const char * name,PyGetSetDef * function_properties=nullptr,PyMethodDef * function_methods=nullptr)
